verses.en: O LORD God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.
verses.pt: Ó Deus das vinganças, SENHOR Deus das vinganças, mostra-te com teu brilho!
verses.en_web: Yahweh, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.
verses.en_bbe: O God, in whose hands is punishment, O God of punishment, let your shining face be seen.

verses.en: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.
verses.pt: Exalta-te, ó Juiz da terra! Retribui com punição aos arrogantes.
verses.en_web: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.
verses.en_bbe: Be lifted up, O judge of the earth; let their reward come to the men of pride.

verses.en: LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?
verses.pt: Até quando os perversos, SENHOR, até quando os perversos se alegrarão?
verses.en_web: Yahweh, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?
verses.en_bbe: How long will sinners, O Lord, how long will sinners have joy over us?

verses.en: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?
verses.pt: Eles falam demais, e dizem palavras soberbas; todos os que praticam a maldade se orgulham.
verses.en_web: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.
verses.en_bbe: Words of pride come from their lips; all the workers of evil say great things of themselves.

verses.en: They break in pieces thy people, O LORD, and afflict thine heritage.
verses.pt: Eles despedaçam ao teu povo, SENHOR, e humilham a tua herança.
verses.en_web: They break your people in pieces, Yahweh, and afflict your heritage.
verses.en_bbe: Your people are crushed by them, O Lord, your heritage is troubled,

verses.en: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.
verses.pt: Eles matam a viúva e o estrangeiro, e tiram a vida dos órfãos.
verses.en_web: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.
verses.en_bbe: They put to death the widow and the guest, they take the lives of children who have no father;

verses.en: Yet they say, The LORD shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard it.
verses.pt: E dizem: O SENHOR não vê isso, e o Deus de Jacó não está prestando atenção.
verses.en_web: They say, “Yah will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”
verses.en_bbe: And they say, Jah will not see it, the God of Jacob will not give thought to it.

verses.en: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?
verses.pt: Entendei, ó tolos dentre o povo; e vós que sois loucos, quando sereis sábios?
verses.en_web: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?
verses.en_bbe: Give your mind to my words, you who are without wisdom among the people; you foolish men, when will you be wise?

verses.en: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?
verses.pt: Por acaso aquele que criou os ouvidos não ouviria? Aquele que formou os olhos não veria?
verses.en_web: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?
verses.en_bbe: Has he by whom your ears were planted no hearing? or is he blind by whom your eyes were formed?

verses.en: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know?
verses.pt: Aquele que disciplina as nações não castigaria? É ele o que ensina o conhecimento ao homem.
verses.en_web: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.
verses.en_bbe: He who is the judge of the nations, will he not give men the reward of their acts, even he who gives knowledge to man?

verses.en: The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.
verses.pt: O SENHOR conhece os pensamentos do homem, que são inúteis.
verses.en_web: Yahweh knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord has knowledge of the thoughts of man, for they are only a breath.

verses.en: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O LORD, and teachest him out of thy law;
verses.pt: Bem-aventurado é o homem a quem tu disciplinas, SENHOR, e em tua Lei o ensinas;
verses.en_web: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Yah, and teach out of your law;
verses.en_bbe: Happy is the man who is guided by you, O Jah, and to whom you give teaching out of your law;

verses.en: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.
verses.pt: Para tu lhe dares descanso dos dias de aflição, até que seja cavada a cova para o perverso.
verses.en_web: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.
verses.en_bbe: So that you may give him rest from the days of evil, till a hole is made ready for the destruction of the sinners.

verses.en: For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
verses.pt: Pois o SENHOR não abandonará o seu povo, nem desamparará a sua herança.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will not give up his people, or take away his support from his heritage;

verses.en: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.
verses.pt: Porque o juízo restaurará a justiça, e todos os corretos de coração o seguirão.
verses.en_web: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.
verses.en_bbe: But decisions will again be made in righteousness; and they will be kept by all whose hearts are true.

verses.en: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
verses.pt: Quem se levantará em meu favor contra os malfeitores? Quem se porá em meu favor contra os praticantes de perversidade?
verses.en_web: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?
verses.en_bbe: Who will give me help against the sinners? and who will be my support against the workers of evil?

verses.en: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.
verses.pt: Se o SENHOR não tivesse sido meu socorro, minha alma logo teria vindo a morar no silêncio da morte.
verses.en_web: Unless Yahweh had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.
verses.en_bbe: If the Lord had not been my helper, my soul would quickly have gone down into death.

verses.en: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.
verses.pt: Quando eu dizia: Meu pé está escorregando;Tua bondade, ó SENHOR, me sustentava.
verses.en_web: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.
verses.en_bbe: If I say, My foot is slipping; your mercy, O Lord, is my support.

verses.en: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
verses.pt: Quando minhas preocupações se multiplicavam dentro de mim, teus consolos confortaram a minha alma.
verses.en_web: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
verses.en_bbe: Among all my troubled thoughts, your comforts are the delight of my soul.

verses.en: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?
verses.pt: Por acaso teria comunhão contigo o trono da maldade, que faz leis opressivas?
verses.en_web: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?
verses.en_bbe: What part with you has the seat of sin, which makes evil into a law?

verses.en: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
verses.pt: Muitos se juntam contra a alma do justo, e condenam o sangue inocente.
verses.en_web: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
verses.en_bbe: They are banded together against the soul of the upright, to give decisions against those who have done no wrong.

verses.en: But the LORD is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.
verses.pt: Mas o SENHOR é meu alto retiro, e meu Deus a rocha de meu refúgio.
verses.en_web: But Yahweh has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.
verses.en_bbe: But the Lord is my safe resting-place; my God is the Rock where I am safe.

verses.en: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, the LORD our God shall cut them off.
verses.pt: E ele fará voltar sobre eles suas próprias perversidades, e por suas maldades ele os destruirá; o SENHOR nosso Deus os destruirá.
verses.en_web: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. Yahweh, our God, will cut them off.
verses.en_bbe: And he has made their evil designs come back on themselves, cutting them off in their sin; the Lord our God will put an end to them.
